content: Hi, I wanted to begin importing and exporting some content between Tau Ceti and Prove2Me. This will also help me make better interoperability tools between "lean package" format and "dependency graph" format. Do you have any suggestions about which small part of Tau Ceti to import to Prove2Me, and which part of Prove2Me might be useful to import into Tau Ceti? I would like this to be useful and helpful.
